profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at Travelers
profile.summary:
Java/Guidewire Technical Lead - Developer

Expert software engineer specializing in Java and Guidewire, with 9 years of experience contributing and developing the software development lifecycle for international projects. Skilled at interpreting client requirements to define technical specifications for implementing new features. 

Hands-on Senior Consultant highly skilled at implementing cutting edge computing solutions, complicated algorithms, financial systems, options/futures markets, based on Core Java 8, RESTFul Web Services, SOAP Web Services, Spring-Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Core, Concurrency, synchronization and locking. Patterns (Factory Method, Façade, Singleton…), Guidewire Configuration, Guidewire Integration, Guidewire Claim Center, Guidewire Policy Center.

positions.title: Product Consultant / Tech Leader at Cognizant
Consultant at Capgemini
positions.description:
Programmed, evaluated and proposed solution for Guidewire Claim Center Project; GW Claim Center Upgrade Project from version 7 to version 9.

Achievements:
•	Playing as Tech Lead role in client side.
•	Upgraded successfully Claim Center from version 7 to version 9 with best quality in difficult situation (upgrade Claim Center, webserver and Oracle database in the same time).
•	Propose analysis, resolve high complexity issues in Guidewire Claim Center (configuration, integration, unit test).
•	Joined estimation process for implementing integration between CC and PC.
•	Have ability to work with PL/SQL for resolving problem from data.
•	Unit test combine GUnit with EasyMock and Reflection.
•	Improving knowledge about insurance domain and soft skill in international environment.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.locationName: 106 Nguyen Van Troi Street, Phu Nhuan District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
   - Team Leader for Kolumbus ADM Project.
   - Apply Guidewire technical solution for resolving client business issues.
   - Analyze and propose technical solution for client.
   - Implement new features for client system.
   - Upgrade and migrate old system to new system using Guidewire Platform.

Projects:
   -  Kolumbus (Claim Center, Contact Manager, Policy Center) 
   -  ING (ClaimCenter)
   -  Kemper Upgrade (ClaimCenter v6 to ClaimCenter v8)

Tools: Git, SVN, IntelliJ, SoapUI, Eclipse
